text:
Maya: Dropped a new compact first-run mock — checklist left, tiny sample strip on the right (collapsed by default). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-onboard (frame 'Checklist + Strip'). Quick thoughts?

Jess: Cleaner. Main question: will collapsed strip be discoverable enough? Maybe a subtle one-time pulse on first session.

Sam: Dev note: make the toggle a real <button> and put it early in DOM so keyboard users see it. Add data-qa="onboard-samples-toggle".

Priya: A11y: contrast on the pill is 3.7:1 in the mock — needs 4.5:1. Also ensure focus is clearly visible and touch target >=44px. Add aria-expanded on the toggle and aria-live="polite" for step changes.

Dan: Analytics: track sample_impression, sample_expand, sample_click, and whether activation was keyboard vs pointer. Jess can you add those events?

Rina: Microcopy: short mobile CTA "Try sample"; desktop can show "Use sample project". Also include a tiny "Why samples?" link under checklist.

a11y-bot: Automated scan: missing aria-label on collapse chevron. Recommend aria-label="Expand sample projects" / "Collapse sample projects". Also flag small text over images for contrast.

Maya: Thanks — plan: update Figma (bump contrast, add a11y notes, mobile copy, and pulse variant respecting prefers-reduced-motion), prepare a 5-task keyboard script, and post updates here by EOD.

Jess: Sounds good. I'll add the GA experiment for a small pilot (1k users per arm) and wire the events.

Sam: I'll prepare a tiny PR to reorder DOM so toggle is first interactive element and include data-qa markers.

Priya: One more: include SR walkthrough notes in Figma (focus moves, announcements).

Maya: Will do. Thanks everyone!
